items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: We used to call him Michael... I don't know why everybody called him -- we used to call him Professor Michael, or Lieutenant.

ctx.x: Well, it was '25, then, whatever it was. Whatever it was. So -- well, it ties in about this Mikell, Mikell, yeah, that's what Stanley Dance's name is. We used to call him Michael.

items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: So that band -- so when we were shipped out, the band, authorized band, wasn't under the jurisdiction of the regiment. So when the band was shipped out the Colonel took all the musicians who were attached to the band with him... So I was attached to the band. I was a member of Headquarters Company.

ctx.x: Well, it was '25, then, whatever it was. Whatever it was. So -- well, it ties in about this Mikell, Mikell, yeah, that's what Stanley Dance's name is. We used to call him Michael.
